# Goal

## Step 1

Here, I am generating a *random* population.  Then I **simulate** taking a sample of 100 values and plptiing the mean.

```{r}

# make a populations of 10000 babies with mean of 3300 and sd of 500
myPopulation <- rnorm(10000, mean = 3300, sd = 500)

# create somewhere to story the 10000 values
myResult <- numeric(length = 10000)

# repeat this process 10,000 times

for(i in 1:10000){
  mySample <- sample(myPopulation, 100)
  myMean <- mean(mySample)
#  print(myMean)
#store the mean in myReults vector  
  myResult[i] <- myMean
}

#plot a histogram

hist(myResult, xlim = c(2600,3900), 
     main = "Distribution of sample means",
     xlab = "Sample mean", 
     col = "red")

```

# Interpretation

This is really interesting.  It shows that the sample means are tightly disttinbited with a sample size fo 100.
